turns.t: Hello! I'm so sorry to be back, I feel like I'm wasting your time, but this throat just won't go.
Not wasting it at all. When did it start, and what's happened since? ~
Nine days ago, and it started with a scratchy bit, and then it got worse and I couldn't swallow properly, so I went to the pharmacy and they gave me a course of something.
Do you know what it was? ~
A course, antibiotics I think, I finished it yesterday, and I thought it'd be gone, but it's not, it's actually worse, my left ear hurts when I swallow too.
So you've had a sore throat for nine days and it's not improving. How would you rate the pain?
It's bad. I'd say severe at the moment. I can't eat toast.
Any fever?
No, no fever, I've been taking my temperature. It's been normal.
Do you have any allergies, particularly to antibiotics?
Penicillin, I believe. I know I react to it, but I honestly can't remember what happened. It was years ago and Mum told me not to take it.
That's very useful, so we'll avoid that whole family. Anything else in your medical history?
Just asthma, but it's mild.
Okay. Let's look at your throat. Open wide and say ahh. ~
Ahhh.
Your tonsils are red and swollen, and there are white patches on both of them.
Is that bad? ~
It tells me there's a bacterial infection on the tonsils. It fits with tonsillitis, so I'd say bacterial tonsillitis is the likely cause.
But I took the antibiotics. ~
The pharmacy course may have been the wrong type or too short. And in your case, some of the commonest ones are the ones you can't take. ~
Right, because of the penicillin. ~
Exactly. So I'm going to start you on clarithromycin, 500 mg twice a day, for five days.
Is that different? ~
It's a different family, which you can take safely with your penicillin reaction. It's for the throat infection, and take it with food.
Okay. Anything else I should do? ~
Plenty of fluids, soft food, and rest. Gargling with warm salty water can ease the soreness.
I like a gargle. ~
You should notice a difference after two days. If you don't, come back. ~
Will I need to come back anyway? ~
Yes, I'd like to see you in a week to be sure it's gone, especially with the ear pain.
A week. Perfect. Thank you so much. ~
Look after yourself. ~

clinical_actions.description: Start Clarithromycin 500 mg twice a day
Advise fluids, soft food, rest and warm salt-water gargles
